primary_result.record_valid_scope: independent physical trace AND collector action/sensor/time integrity

post_retreat_window.geometry_scope: Independent actual-pose input-material samples/intersection checks; actual cooked surface global error remains unknown

grasp_relative_pose.position_reference: Vessel bottom-frame origin in hand frame; includes rotation lever-arm motion, not isolated axial slip.
grasp_relative_pose.anchor_reference: Configured body point[0,0,grasp_height] in hand frame, not measured contact pressure centre. Anchor metrics are analysis only; existing acceptance gates unchanged.

static_grasp.boundary_definition: Independent observed physical lift/source-clear/near-target events; teacher phase ignored

extraction.boundary_definition: Independent observed physical lift/source-clear/near-target events; teacher phase ignored

transport.boundary_definition: Independent observed physical lift/source-clear/near-target events; teacher phase ignored

primary_result.acceptance_geometry_scope: Declared input material geometry checks plus actual physical contact and motion, not calibrated cooked geometry or real accuracy

asset_family.parameters_location: Full35-asset physical metadata is in the separate Size_v1_current/asset_summary.json and the copied dimensions_mass_and_inertia.csv; original registry source path/SHA is in sources.

geometry_scope.translation_search: Same full polygonal boundedXY configuration-space algorithm at every width/yaw; not centre-only
geometry_scope.range_scope: Observed tested size hypotheses, not a real specimen inference. Positive conservative sweep means clearance of authored triangle surfaces. False conservative gate is inconclusive; four-yaw entrance rejects do not exclude arbitrary inclined6DOF paths.

cooked_convex_surface_samples.scope: Vertices and triangle face centroids to triangle surfaces, per input block; no compound union exterior error/global Hausdorff bound or absence-of-fallback proof

cooked_scope_limitations: Convex cooking request output is not attached PxShape pointer-level readback.
Per-block surface samples do not identify compound union exposed exterior or cavity-fill globally.
215 of976 source face identifiers observed does not establish remaining surfaces are absent.
Static full triangle vertices and explicit per-shape effective fallback remain unknown.
No task insertion, release, retreat or post-retreat stability evaluated in this preview.

camera.association_summary: 主记录同观测renderer与当前USD的位置关联通过数为侧视6348/6348、腕视6348/6348，计算门槛为1e-8m。两路实际RGB帧数分别为6348、6348，动作与后继状态对齐结果随读取核验JSON保存。这确认记录中的状态关联，不是实物光学标定、接触精度或精确曝光延迟的证明。

camera.sync_scope_limitations: Actual renderer-to-USD observation association; not physical precision, collision penetration or real optical calibration. Near-previous-pose equality does not alone establish exact RGB exposure latency. record_valid does not certify zero latency.
